conf.description: FireEye EX ex-alert JSON extended fenotify feed: strip-free JSON extract, flatten nested alert object into ECS per recommendations.direct.cribl with EX email semantics (smtp-mail-from/smtp-to/smtp-message, attachment-not-network malware object), keep _raw and os-changes since no guard exists on this route.

conf.comment: fireeye / ex-alert / json (fenotify extended verbosity via CM eMPS channel). Mirrors nx-alert's envelope+flatten approach but with EX email semantics: alert.src.smtp-mail-from / alert.dst.smtp-to / alert.smtp-message.* replace the NX's network-object fields, and malware-detected.malware carries attachment semantics (original=filename) rather than a network detection. Per recommendations.direct.cribl: normalize malware to an array before mapping, honor the explicit-offset alert.occurred, retain os-changes since there is no guard on this route (never let it reach host.os.*), and translate malware.type through a lookup only when one exists -- none is supplied here, so the raw vendor token is kept on email.attachments.file.mime_type (gap noted in README). alert.action's quarantined/blocked nuance is lost in ECS event.type, so the raw token is retained on fireeye.ex.action_raw. Keeps _raw.

hyphenated-source bracket reads (THE BIG ONE recipe) against the still-nested alert object, severity/action lookups with raw-action retention, timestamp parses honoring explicit offset, email envelope fields, dataset/category tags

normalize malware-detected.malware object-or-array shape into email.attachments/rule fields, copy os-changes trace, split MITRE sub-technique id/name, then delete the now-fully-consumed msg/alert branches
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
